rules.title: Quote root must be <blockquote>
rules.description: The .quote class must be applied to a <blockquote> element. Using <div> or other non-semantic elements removes the quotation semantics from the accessibility tree.
rules.message: The .quote class is applied to a non-blockquote element. Use <blockquote class="quote">.
rules.fix: Change the root element to <blockquote class="quote" dir="ltr">.

rules.title: Author name must use <cite>
rules.description:
The .quote__author-name class should be applied to a element to convey semantic attribution. Using or

removes the citation semantics.
rules.message: Author name (.quote__author-name) is not a <cite> element. Screen readers may not identify this as a citation.

rules.title: Author attribution section should use <footer>
rules.description: The .quote__author-details class should be applied to a <footer> element inside the <blockquote> to semantically scope the attribution.
rules.message: Author details (.quote__author-details) is not a <footer> element. Use <footer> for semantic attribution scoping.

rules.title: Quote must have dir attribute set
rules.description: The .quote root element or an ancestor must have a dir attribute ('ltr' or 'rtl') to ensure correct text direction and CSS layout. Absence of dir attribute may result in incorrect quote mark positioning and layout alignment.
rules.expected: element or an ancestor has dir attribute with value 'ltr' or 'rtl'
rules.message: No dir attribute found on .quote or its ancestors. Set dir='ltr' or dir='rtl' to ensure correct layout and text direction.
rules.fix: Add dir="ltr" or dir="rtl" to the <blockquote class="quote"> element.

rules.title: Decorative quote marks must not generate meaningful accessible names
rules.description: The decorative " and " marks are rendered via CSS ::before/::after pseudo-elements using content alt text ('/ ""'). Verify that no HTML element containing literal quotation mark characters " or " exists inside .quote — these would be announced by screen readers redundantly.
rules.expected: no child elements contain standalone U+201C or U+201D characters as content

check.note: Static analysis cannot fully verify pseudo-element rendering. Verify in browser with screen reader.

rules.message: Verify that opening and closing quotation marks are only rendered via CSS pseudo-elements, not HTML text nodes.
rules.fix: Remove any HTML text nodes containing " or " from inside .quote. These characters are managed exclusively by CSS ::before and ::after.

rules.title: Quote must contain .quote__text
rules.description: .quote__text is the required slot. A quote without visible text content is incomplete.
rules.expected: element contains a child with class 'quote__text'
rules.message: Quote is missing .quote__text. Every quote must contain a text element.

rules.title: Quote must contain .quote__body
rules.description: .quote__body is required. It provides the horizontal inset padding for the quote content.
rules.expected: element contains a child with class 'quote__body'
rules.message: Quote is missing .quote__body wrapper. The body container is required for correct layout.

rules.title: RTL must not be applied via modifier class
rules.description: RTL layout is controlled by the [dir='rtl'] CSS selector, not a modifier class like .quote--rtl. Using a modifier class will not activate the RTL CSS rules.
rules.message: RTL modifier class .quote--rtl found. RTL layout is activated by dir='rtl' attribute, not a class.
rules.fix: Remove .quote--rtl class. Add dir="rtl" attribute to the <blockquote> element instead.

rules.title: Quote must not use hardcoded color values
rules.description: All color values in .quote and its children must use CSS custom properties. Hardcoded hex, rgb, or rgba values bypass the token system.
rules.expected: color, background, and background-color properties use var(--*) not raw color values
rules.message: Hardcoded color found in .quote or a child element. Replace with the appropriate design token.
rules.fix: Replace hardcoded color with the corresponding --quote-* token from reference.json.
